name: mnemic
description: Long-term memory for your assistant: what you told it, kept as dated facts in one local SQLite file, recalled before it answers.
long_description: Mnemic remembers what you tell your assistant across conversations and hands it back when it matters: the current job, the home, the family, the decision from last month, the thing you said you would do. Facts carry when they were true, so a corrected fact keeps its history and a question about 2019 gets the 2019 answer. Everything lives in one SQLite file in a folder you choose; no account, no service, and no model call unless you configure one. On first start Mnemic downloads its embedding model (about 350 MB, from Hugging Face) into the models folder under your home directory; after that it works offline. Enter your name in the settings so that "I" and "me" mean you.

owner.title: Your name
owner.description: The person "I", "me", and "my" refer to, as you want it rendered in facts, for example Alice Example.

data_dir.title: Data home
data_dir.description: Where the memory is kept: one SQLite file, mnemic.db, and a log. Back up this folder and your memory is safe. Point a second assistant at a different folder to give it a memory of its own. A leading ~ means your home directory.

owner_aliases.title: Other names
owner_aliases.description: Nicknames or the surname alone, comma-separated, so that they resolve to you as well. Leave empty if none.

owner_emails.title: E-mail addresses
owner_emails.description: Comma-separated. Useful when the memory is used for code or mail work, where addresses appear in what is remembered.

owner_github.title: GitHub handle
owner_github.description: Without the @. Commits and issues carry it.

owner_handles.title: Other handles
owner_handles.description: Comma-separated, with or without a leading @, for example @alice_example or slack:alice.
